messages:
Carla Gomez: heads up — noticed console heatmap stutters and a pretty big bundle bump after the last canary. heatmap opens with jank and main-thread spikes.
Ben Park: which canary / PR? saw a telemetry change land earlier.
Carla Gomez: the `telemetry/eager-init` PR — it pulled telemetry-proxy onto main. bundle +~210KB gz, and I see frame drops when the heatmap mounts.
Dan Li: also FYI we merged a KV-prefetch routing tweak yesterday (`routing.affinity = true`). kvcache.evictions spiked in staging around the same time. could be compounding.
Carla Gomez: exact. devtools snippet: `Long Tasks` cluster when heatmap paints, and `kvcache.evictions` shows bursts.

Code snippet (config change that went in):
```
routing:
  policy: "affinity"
  prefetch_window: 50
telemetry:
  eager_init: true
```
Erin O'Neil: @deploy-bot can you post the canary id and commits so we know what's in the rollout? :eyes: 
deploy-bot: Canary deployed: console-canary-42 @ 6312345600
commits: abc123 (telemetry eager-init), def456 (routing affinity)
Ben Park: i'd prefer reverting telemetry eager-init first — it looks like the biggest main-thread parse hit. we can measure SLO impact before touching routing.
Dan Li: routing affinity could still be making kvcache churn worse though. i can add temporary instrumentation (eviction counters + prefix-hit ratio) and throttle prefetch_window to test.
Carla Gomez: can we rollback telemetry eager-init in EU-only canary? minimize blast radius while we isolate.
Erin O'Neil: opening rollback PR now — will add a feature flag so we can toggle without full rollback. also will set prefetch_window -> 10 as a stopgap.
Ben Park: local repro numbers: telemetry=true -> heatmap LCP 1.42s, main CPU ~62%. telemetry=false -> LCP 1.03s, main CPU ~44%. will paste full numbers in PR.
Dan Li: alternative: lazy-init telemetry on `requestIdleCallback` or after first paint to avoid blocking initial render. we should prefer lazy-init + feature flag.
Carla Gomez: agreed. follow-ups: (1) rollback eager-init in canary, (2) add lazy-init implementation, (3) add deploy-time guard that alerts if bundle gz growth >100KB, (4) instrument kvcache metrics.
Erin O'Neil: PR #3789 opened: rollback eager-init in canary + runtime flag + prefetch_window change. tagging @Ben @Dan for review. :spiral_notepad:
deploy-bot: Rollout initiated: console-canary-43 (eu) @ 6312345900 — monitoring: metric=heatmap.LCP, kvcache.evictions, bundle.size.gz
Carla Gomez: i'm watching the LCP dashboards. will report back in 15m. please ping here if you see anything odd.
Ben Park: after rollback we should run a perf smoke against dedicated capacity too (different routing/kv profiles).
Dan Li: will add the eviction counters and a short-lived dashboard panel to the canary namespace. should help confirm whether affinity prefetch is the secondary culprit.
Carla Gomez: thanks all. once canary stabilizes let's do a small canary-to-prod checklist: perf smoke, telemetry sample sanity, and bundle-size alert baseline. :thumbsup:
